title: Can websites detect temporary email addresses?
excerpt: Yes, often. Blocklists, MX lookups, and domain-age checks catch most disposable domains. How detection works and what to use when a site says no.
meta_title: Can websites detect temporary email addresses?
meta_description: How signup forms detect disposable email — blocklists, MX checks, domain-age heuristics — why domain rotation only partly helps, and what to use instead.
